content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_OF_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: This Notice of Eviction is given to inform you that you are in violation of the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_REASONS_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: The reasons for this eviction are failure to pay rent in a timely manner and damage to the rental property.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ACTION_REQUIRED
content_blocks.text: You must vacate the premises within fifteen days from the date of this notice.
